learningObjectives: Organize interface content into a clear information hierarchy.
Create logical user flows for common tasks.
Identify navigation patterns that reduce user effort.

activities.title: Information Architecture Map
activities.instruction: Explore how content is organized into a hierarchy.

content.concept: Information architecture structures content, navigation, and relationships so users can find what they need.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Navigation Pattern Match
activities.instruction: Match each navigation pattern to its use case.

content.concept: Tabs, navigation bars, breadcrumbs, menus, and search support different navigation needs and content structures.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: User Flow Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps to complete a user task.

content.concept: A user flow represents the sequence of actions and decisions required to complete a specific goal.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Flow Friction Lab
activities.instruction: Identify the step that creates unnecessary friction.

content.concept: Reducing unnecessary steps, decisions, and navigation changes can make task completion more efficient.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
